# Robert Kovacs

> CTO at FirstPromoter. Ruby on Rails, performance, and scaling.

## About

Robert Kovacs is the CTO at [FirstPromoter](https://firstpromoter.com/?fpr=robert), based in Lisbon, Portugal. FirstPromoter is an affiliate tracking platform powering 7,000+ affiliate programs, processing 10M+ payment webhooks per week from Stripe, Chargebee, Braintree, and Paddle.

Previously he worked at ROOM Inc. (real-time IoT platform), Net-a-Porter (micro frontend checkout), Partbot (automotive e-commerce), and Wolfpack Digital (fintech/healthcare).

## Technical Focus

Ruby on Rails performance at scale, PostgreSQL optimization, Redis caching, Sidekiq background processing, Google BigQuery analytics, and affiliate/referral tracking systems.
